description: This file defines a Scaler interface and its implementation for scaling Kubernetes resources, including methods for scaling resources, validating preconditions, and waiting for desired replica counts.

classes.name: Scaler
classes.description: Interface for resources that can be scaled, with methods for scaling and simple scaling attempts.

classes.name: PreconditionError
classes.description: Error indicating a precondition for scaling was not met.

classes.name: RetryParams
classes.description: Encapsulates retry interval and timeout durations for scaling operations.

classes.name: genericScaler
classes.description: Implementation of the Scaler interface, managing scale operations for Kubernetes resources.

methods.name: NewScaler
methods.description: Creates a new Scaler instance given a scale client getter.

methods.name: ScaleSimple
methods.description: Performs a one-shot scale operation, returning the resource version.

methods.name: Scale
methods.description: Performs a scalable operation with optional retries and waiting for desired replicas.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates preconditions against a scale object.
